title: Identity access token v1
description: RS256 JWT (typ at+jwt) issued by Identity for downstream runtimes. Consumers verify signature, iss, aud, exp and required claims locally; optional introspection rejects revoked sessions immediately.

scope.description: Space-delimited scopes allowed for the token audience.

amr.description: Authentication methods. pwd is always present; totp or webauthn appear after an active step-up grant.

aud.description: Target runtime audience, for example nvbes-account-service.

sid.description: Session bound to this access token.
